w: While Swamishri was having breakfast, the students residing at the hostel described the various DAYS (Rose Day, Chocolate Day, ...) celebrated in colleges. After keenly listening to them. Swamishri suggested, "Have a tilak-chandlo day." A youth enquired, "Do all the students have to do it?" Swamishri, "Well, don’t all the students observe the Days? Instead of observing such Days what is wrong with tilak-chandlo day!" The students appreciated Swamishri’s insight and revelation that the DAYS celebrated in colleges have no cultural, moral or spiritual significance. It would be beneficial and inspiring to have meaningful DAYS.
Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by devotees in the evening assembly.

Children's Day In the evening assembly, children recited Swamini Vatos, narrated stories, sang kirtans and performed monoacting. Finally, Swamishri addressed the assembly, "The children have performed well. They are like saplings. If they are cared for they will grow into giant trees and bear abundant fruits. Children are our wealth. We endeavor immensely to acquire mundane wealth and assets. We even take care in looking after it and utilising it in the best of ways. And, we are never careless in this matter. So too, children are our wealth."
During the evening assembly Swamishri inaugurated the Shri Swaminarayan Mandir Neasden, London, web site - www.mandir.org

st.t: Swamishri Inaugurated Website of Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden, London
w: H.D.H. Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurated the London mandir website, www.mandir.org., during the Sunday satsang assembly of 8,000 devotees in Amdavad. As details of the Mandir site were being announced Swamishri displayed a large replica of the colorful site homepage. The devotees applauded the inauguration and announcement of www.mandir.org . The site was prepared through the inspiration of Swamishri and the efforts of sadhus and youth volunteers of the www.swaminarayan.org website team in Amdavad.

Kishore - Kishori National Convention The entire morning session was centred around helping kishores and kishoris deal with peer pressure. Skits and real-life incidents demonstrated the harmful effects of succumbing to this type of pressure. Following this, sadhus offered valuable guidance on how to remain firm in one's convictions in the face of peer pressure. After Swamishri heard about the pressures youths deal with, he emphasised the importance of maintaining strong faith in God and His holy Sadhu. Their commandments lead to purity of the mind and body, and although people may not realise it, they are for our best. Kishores and kishoris observed the shraddh of Shastriji Maharaj during the evening programme, commemorating the life and work of Shastriji Maharaj.

Kishores learned about the hardships he faced, the struggles he overcame, and his persistence and zeal for spreading the Akshar Purushottam Upasana through skits, speeches, and videos. Kishores also asked Swamishri to recount several personal accounts of his experiences with Shastriji Maharaj and his efforts. At the conclusion of the programme, according to tradition, Swamishri served dudhpak to the sadhus, and senior sadhus served all delegates present.
ph: Swamishri and Pujya Ghanshyamcharan Swami play the kartals

w: In the evening assembly Swamishri blessed the devotees, “True wealth is our dharma, virtues and spirituality. They bring happiness in this world and in the next. If we do not have wealth in the form of God everything is wasted. So that wealth is very big.”
Wednesday, 6 July 2005 (Jeth vad 30, Samvat 2061), Jamnagar

After reading letters and after his bath and other routines, Pramukh Swami Maharaj met Steven Hedy, who had come from Houston. Viveksagar Swami had brought him. Through a satsangi youth named Akar living in Houston, Steven had come to the Houston mandir for darshan for the first time. After coming, he was overwhelmed by its peace and divinity and began regularly attending the evening and night arti every Friday. He had come to India specially for darshan. After travelling to many places, today he had come for Swamishri's darshan. Speaking before Swamishri with gratitude, he said, "Thank you very much for giving Houston such a beautiful, inspiring, peaceful mandir. When we go there, we very much feel the touch of spirituality."
"Everything has happened by God's will. It must have been God's will for you too, so you met our student Akar Patel and came into contact with the Houston mandir."

Steven said, "When I go to the mandir, the volunteers there are also very friendly, kind and loving. They always talk only about God. When I go to the arti every Friday, I feel great peace and inspiration, and when I have darshan of the murtis of the mandir and of the guru lineage, I keep experiencing love, compassion, kindness and peace from their eyes."
Swamishri said to him, "You are a spiritual seeker, so your devotion to God has grown."
Further, he said, "I have read the Hindu scriptures. The atma is different from this body. I am trying to understand that."
Swamishri said, "Have you read the Vachanamrut?"
"I read one every day."
Swamishri was pleased and blessed him.

A youth had come for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. This youth had been engaged a little while ago. After the engagement, there were frequent visits to each other's homes. Once the youth went with his elders to his fiancée's home. The atmosphere there seemed rather free. The youth's father felt that the girl was, in today's fashion, too sociable. Seeing the girl's behaviour, mixing freely with their relatives, the youth's father became suspicious. So after coming home he decided to break off the engagement.

The youth took this lightly. On this point, ill feeling arose between father and son and it turned into something like a quarrel. Both were stubborn about their own view. When the other side came to know of this, the girl gave an explanation and also gave an assurance that she would take care that such behaviour did not happen in future. The youth told Swamishri the whole story in detail. Swamishri listened to him lovingly.
Explaining to the youth's father on the phone, Swamishri said:

"Even if the girl did perhaps make a mistake, she has apologised. When anyone apologises, we should keep a large heart, shouldn't we! So rather than breaking it off, get them married. Shriji Maharaj will be compassionate." At a single word from Swamishri, the father gave up his prejudice and agreed. Further, Swamishri added, "After making this decision, even when your son comes home, do not speak harshly to him or scold him. Act with love and affection. Join in the wedding too with love and affection."

Swamishri knows the secrets of the human mind. In many such matters that have reached the brink of breaking, the trust that Swamishri gives works as an unbreakable bond. In this way Swamishri has saved the social standing of many, and the futures of many too.

After concluding his morning puja Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan of the marble murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, and Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami performed pujan of Swamishri’s murti. The murtis were to be consecrated at the Sanatan Mandir in Valetva (near Mahelav). Swamishri blessed a 61-year-old devotee, Shri Darshansingh, for pilgrimaging 275 km by foot from Chandigadh to Akshardham.

Today during breakfast, Mahant Swami Maharaj recalled the kirtan "Pramukh Swami charan dhare tya Kashi..." (wherever Pramukh Swami sets his feet is Kashi), sung by Shukmunidas Swami during the puja, and said, "The words of the kirtan were full of feeling."
One sadhu said, "Swamishri turned the mala for 5 minutes longer today."
Swamishri said, "Yes, I got lost in the words of the kirtan."
What devotion to the guru! He becomes absorbed in hearing the praises of his guru.

ds.t: We have come to your home
w: Today a devotee named Jashbhai Chhotabhai Patel came for a personal meeting. Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "We have come to your home." The devotee was very pleased at Swamishri's memory.
This devotee is a native of Sanjaya village near Vadtal. In 2002, Swamishri had stayed at Jashbhai's home on the occasion of the foundation ceremony for a water tank.
This is Swamishri's sharp memory! It shows that he is very closely bonded with the devotees.
